name: attachment-remove-touch-wide
description: composer attachment tile on a wide touch screen (above the 900px phone breakpoint, coarse pointer): the remove control is visible at rest and meets the 44px tap floor, and its hit box never covers the thumbnail's centre or a neighbouring tile, so a tap on the image opens the lightbox instead of removing the attachment

mutation.declaration: composer.module.css touch block: the (any-pointer: coarse) half of @media (max-width: 899px), (any-pointer: coarse) removed
mutation.note: Fails: a tap at the first thumbnail's centre lands on first-remove, not first-open.
